note: Hand-kept. AC (Type 2, up to 22 kW) list prices per kWh read on opened operator pages. Not verified data: always say 'check operator'. ac is null when no figure was read on an opened page. start_fee/idle_fee null means not stated on the page read. Prices include VAT. adhoc_kwh is the no-subscription price (a 'from' price where the page says so); member_kwh needs registration, an app or a subscription. match.ocm_names are exact Operator titles from the Open Charge Map reference data (checked 2026-11-07); nobil_names are unverified hints (no NOBIL call made).
